post.description: Explicit secrets.write capability and fresh local authentication. Set requires exactly text/plain with charset=utf-8, 1..65536 UTF-16 code units and at most 196608 wire bytes. Keep and clear require an empty body. Secret bytes appear only in this dedicated body, never in URL, headers or ordinary DTO. Repeated operation IDs require the same field/revision/disposition and keyed value proof; requests to another logical owner conflict without revealing the original result.
